subject: Isolated hosting: cross-functional playbook questions and resource asks (Brightwell pilot)
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-07-05 09:12 PDT
Subject: Isolated hosting: cross-functional playbook questions and resource asks (Brightwell pilot)

Hi team —

Brightwell has asked us to validate a small pilot for a fully isolated VPC + on-prem adjacency (they want an isolated subnet for inference, a dedicated ingress VPN, and an offline data-sweep path). Before I lock in dates with their infra lead, I need cross-functional input on a few items so we can agree whether this is a pilot we can support without a formal exception. Summary of asks:  

1) Architecture: Can we support a lightweight on-prem adjacency for model artifacts + KV cache eviction without building a full air-gapped distro? Karthik — what are minimal infra patterns we can reuse?
2) Ops/Staffing: What on-call and runbook changes are required for a pilot limited to one customer? Prio: who must be oncall during the pilot window?
3) Security/Compliance: Lauren — what evidence (logs, KMS integration, attestations) do we need to collect to satisfy Brightwell's security team?
4) Timeline & scope: Stephanie — can we do a 4-week pilot target starting Aug 6 if we scope to 1 model variant and 2 endpoints?

I attached a quick network sketch and an ops staffing matrix I cobbled together from prior pilots (network_design_v1.pdf, ops_staffing_matrix.xlsx). Brightwell also sent an NSA-style questionnaire that I parsed (brightwell_nsa_req.pdf).  

Please reply inline with clear yes/no and the minimal blockers. If we can't commit to the Aug 6 start, say so and propose alternatives.

Thanks —
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-05 11:04 PDT
Subject: Re: Isolated hosting: cross-functional playbook questions and resource asks (Brightwell pilot)

Maya — thanks for the concise list. Quick architecture notes:  

- Minimal pattern: we can run a hosted inference tier inside a customer-dedicated VPC (Redwood-managed control plane with private endpoints). For on-prem adjacency (artifact sync + KV cache eviction), propose an SFTP + mTLS pull model where Brightwell's appliance pulls model blobs and the KV eviction hints are exchanged over a VPN. This avoids inbound firewall holes.
- Constraints: we currently do not have an automated artifact-signing + HSM flow for customer pulls — we'd use signed tarballs with checksum verification and a short-lived API key for the pilot. That is acceptable for a 4-week pilot but would require a product backlog ticket for production.
- Network: the attached sketch is fine but we should require a single NAT egress IP for Brightwell so we can whitelist for auditing/egress monitoring.
- Runtime: we can limit to 1 quantized model variant and a small cache size to reduce memory ops and simplify debugging.

Blockers: artifact signing automation (low), VPN churn window for their infra team (medium).

I can draft a minimal architecture appendix by Friday (2028-07-08). Will also note the required changes to our runtime config (sequence length limit and batch size overrides) so ops can pre-configure.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Architect, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-06 08:33 PDT
Subject: Re: Isolated hosting: cross-functional playbook questions and resource asks (Brightwell pilot)

Maya / team — ops perspective:  

- Oncall: For a single-customer pilot we need: 1 x infra-oncall (network/VPN), 1 x runtime-oncall (inference runtime), 1 x escalation owner (SRE lead). Given current rota, we can staff this but it means a new 4-week rota with dedicated shifts — ops will need 6 dedicated engineer-weeks overall (4 weeks * ~1.5 FTE equivalent scheduling overhead).
- Runbooks: we'll need a short runbook with failover steps if the VPN drops (fail to hosted fallback or pause traffic), cache-clear commands, and a post-incident evidence collection checklist. I can template these off INF-1923.
- Tooling: request a temporary traceroute/packet-capture guide for the Brightwell appliance (I will not take packet captures without their approval).
- Time window: Aug 6 start is tight; we need to confirm staffing by July 20 to lock hires/shift swaps. If Karthik's appendix and Lauren's checklist are delivered by Jul 10 we have a chance.

I'll attach a staffing matrix update to the Drive link once we confirm.

- Priyom
Priyom Das
SRE Lead, Dedicated & Private
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-07 09:21 PDT
Subject: Re: Isolated hosting: cross-functional playbook questions and resource asks (Brightwell pilot)

Maya — security checklist notes:  

- Evidence they require (short list): audit logs for model access, KMS-wrapped artfacts (we need to confirm whether customer KMS or our KMS is used), network egress logs for the single NAT IP, and signed change logs for model updates.
- For the pilot, acceptable mitigations: signed artifact bundles + checksum, per-deployment short-lived keys (rotation daily), and an agreed-upon log retention window (90 days).
- If they require HSM-backed attestations or an external attest server, that's a non-trivial exception and will require SOC compliance signoff — that will extend timeline by 6+ weeks.
- Bring your legal/compliance contacts into the thread if Brightwell pushes HSM.

I'll also prepare a minimal evidence catalog by Jul 9.

- Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Choi <sam.choi@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-09 10:10 EDT
Subject: Re: Isolated hosting: cross-functional playbook questions and resource asks (Brightwell pilot)

Hi Maya / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from Brightwell infra:  

- We prefer a pull model for artifacts (their appliance initiates outbound over a dedicated VPN). We will provide a static egress IP and can keep a 90-day retention for logs.
- HSM: not required for pilot. We do request proof of key rotation and an audit trail for model changes. Short-lived keys are OK.
- Timeline: Aug 6 is fine if the following are confirmed by July 20: (a) list of IPs and VPN endpoint, (b) runbook for VPN failure mode, (c) oncall roster.

Sam Choi
Senior Infra Engineer
Brightwell Health
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-12 16:45 PDT
Subject: Re: Isolated hosting: cross-functional playbook questions and resource asks (Brightwell pilot)

Thanks all — capture and next steps:  

- Karthik: please share the architecture appendix and the minimal runtime config by EOD Jul 08 (INF-2145).
- Priyom: draft the 4-week oncall rota and runbook template by Jul 15; include the VPN-failure steps and evidence collection checklist.
- Lauren: publish the minimal evidence catalog by Jul 09; escalate to legal only if Brightwell asks for HSM backings.
- Stephanie: if we get the above by the dates noted, proceed with the Aug 6 start. Please draft the pilot MVP (1 model variant, 2 endpoints, daily smoke test) and the rollback criteria.

I'll draft a mutual-action-plan and send to Sam this week (attaching the items we discussed). If anyone can't meet the deliverable dates, flag in this thread today.

Appended attachments: network_design_v1.pdf, ops_staffing_matrix.xlsx, brightwell_nsa_req.pdf

Maya
